observations: body L1: a small spur is printed at the upper right of the δ-shaped omicron of «ὁ», which has the head of the rough breathing, as «ὁ» in L3; not transcribed.
body L4, L39: the last digit of «٢٧٣» (L4) is 4.7 points wide, that of «٢٧٢» (L39) 3.0 points.
body L6, L7: a short stroke (2.8 by 1.7 points) is printed in the left margin before «الزُّبْرَةُ» (L6), and a raised speck after «Librae» (L7); not transcribed.
body L13, L36, L38, L40: the zero of «٢٠» is printed larger than the other zeros of the page (1.9 by 2.3 points; the zeros of «٢٠٩», «١٠» and «١٣٠» measure 1.5-1.7 by 2.0) and resembles a full stop.

body L14, L15, L16, L35: the 3 and the 9 of «٣٩» (L14, L15) touch (8.3 points); the two digits 3 of «١٣٣» (L16) have two crests each (4.7 points), the two digits 2 of «٢٢» (L35) one crest each, touching (6.2 points together).
body L10, L13, L14, L15, L16: the hamza of the second «أزْمَان» (L16) has no fatḥa, unlike «أَزْمَان» in L10, L13, L14 and L15.
body L17, L19: «ἐκλίψεως» (L17) is printed without the ε of «ἐκλείψεως» (L19); transcribed as printed.

body L18: the hamza of the first «بَدْءُ» is cast with its damma (3.7 by 5.2 points); that of the second «بَدْء» is plain and joined to the dāl. A speck (0.8 point) is printed above the last ο of the first «πρώτου»; not transcribed.
body L18, L28, L35: «بَدْءُ» (L18), «فَرْقَ» and «كوْن» (L28) and «سَائِرٌ» (L35) are printed with elongated joins (kashīda), not transcribed.
body L23, L25, L32, L33: the hyphen of «95-101» is 4.0 points long and thick, as the hyphens of the page (3.0-3.8 points); the en dash of «١٢١–١٢٤» (L32, L33) is 5.3-5.5 points and thin.
body L28: the two dots of the yāʾ of «بين» run together (3.2 by 1.6 points); they are not a kasra.

body L13, L30: «τῆς» is printed before the masculine «ὁρίζοντος»; transcribed as printed. The breathing of «αἱ» is joined to the ι and opens to the right, unlike the separate smooth breathing of «ἰσημερινοῦ» (L13).
body L30, L31: «n. I.» (L31) is printed with the capital I of «t. I», not with the figure 1 of «11» (L30).

body L27, L30, L31: «angulus» at the end of L31 is printed as heavily as the other words at the right end of the lines («agentes», L27; «puncta», L30); it is the ordinary italic, not the bold italic of «ken-» on p. 335.
body L36: the reference «١٩٦{sub:22}» is followed by a full stop (1.7 by 1.8 points), the other references of the line by commas (1.8 by 3.1 points).
body L39: the three digits of «٢٦٦» touch (9.4 points); unlike «٢٢٦» on p. 329, the second and the third digit are joined by a flat stroke without a crest.
body L3, L6, L7, L39: «al-Qazwīnī» (L3, L39) and «aṣ-Ṣūfī» (L6, L7) are printed with a hyphen (3.0-3.4 points), not with the en dash of p. 329.

body L40: the dash before the last «سَبْق» is printed 12.2 points long and thin (0.9 point); the other dashes of the page are 9.6-10.4 points long. A small mark (1.1 by 1.3 points) is printed below «للشمس», and a dot above the L of «Lunae»; not transcribed.

review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
